product_metadata.title: Zober Velvet Hangers 30 Pack - Black Hangers for Coats, Pants & Dress Clothes - Non Slip Clothes Hanger Set w/ 360 Degree Swivel, Holds up to 10 lbs - Strong Felt Hangers for Clothing
features: DURABLE SWEATER HANGERS - Featuring smooth, black, non-slip velvet, 360 degree swivel hooks, and notched shoulders, this coat hanger set makes storage simple and stylish.

STRONG & FIRM GRIP - Whether you need to hang up a 10 lb coat or a thin satin top, these non slip hangers have you covered. The strong hold and grip on this coat hanger will keep your clothes happily hung!
SAVES SPACE - We've designed these felt hangers for all of your closet clearing and organizational purposes. The slim design makes these hangers space saving wonders for your storage needs.

PRESERVES CLOTHING SHAPE - Our clothing hangers' design doesn't stop at strength. Not only are our space saving hangers non slip, but the curved shoulder line preserves the natural shape of your clothing.
ADDED HORIZONTAL BAR - This velvet hanger pack includes a connected bar design, so you don't have to just use them as shirt hangers - you can use them as pants or suit hangers too!
